text.content: Startups are often held up as an example of efficient organizations that ruthlessly execute on their goals. But if you talk to anyone inside a startup, the internal feeling is that everything is on fire and all processes are broken all the time. It turns out they don’t actually optimize their governing structure much; instead, they get to just-not-broken-enough such that institutional intelligence does not bottleneck their main product (whatever the startup sells) on rocketship growth.
